dogecoin.text:
$DOGE is the world record holder for the largest marketcap of all memecoins and the largest marketcap of all Shiba Inu based memecoins.

$PEPE is the world record holder for the largest marketcap of all pepe based memecoins.
The only other memecoin with 2 world records is $DOGE. It is the top memecoin by marketcap and the highest marketcap of all Shiba Inu based memecoins.
